camel_example: aliyun dts UpgradeTwoWay --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId dtsh77p49x4k280000 --InstanceClass large --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Upgrades the synchronization topology of a DTS data synchronization instance from one-way synchronization to two-way synchronization
description_zh: 调用UpgradeTwoWay接口将DTS同步实例的同步拓扑从单向同步升级为双向同步

name: UpgradeTwoWay

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance specification for two-way synchronization. Valid values: large, medium, micro, and small.
For more information about instance specifications, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26605.html
parameters.help_zh:
双向同步的实例规格，取值为large、medium、micro 、small。
链路规格说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26605.html

For example, if the value of ErrMessage is The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and the value of DynamicMessage is InstanceId, the specified value of the request parameter InstanceId is invalid
